title: Learning how to learn
learning_outcomes: Explain learning versus familiarity in the context of learning how to learn.
Compare and distinguish retrieval and spaced practice in the context of learning how to learn.
Apply feedback and transfer in the context of learning how to learn.
Evaluate and justify decisions about build your own learning system in the context of learning how to learn.

lessons.title: Learning versus familiarity
lessons.outcome: Explain learning versus familiarity in the context of learning how to learn.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving learning versus familiarity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to seven-day learning cycle.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain learning versus familiarity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of learning versus familiarity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Retrieval and spaced practice
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish retrieval and spaced practice in the context of learning how to learn.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving retrieval and spaced practice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to seven-day learning cycle.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain retrieval and spaced practice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of retrieval and spaced practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Feedback and transfer
lessons.outcome: Apply feedback and transfer in the context of learning how to learn.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving feedback and transfer; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to seven-day learning cycle.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain feedback and transfer from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of feedback and transfer; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Build your own learning system
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about build your own learning system in the context of learning how to learn.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving build your own learning system; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to seven-day learning cycle.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain build your own learning system from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of build your own learning system; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of learning versus familiarity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of retrieval and spaced practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of feedback and transfer; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of build your own learning system; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
